claim: A video shows people in Pakistan are uprooting the trees planted as part of Imran Khan’s plantation campaign because they consider planting trees as "unIslamic".
evidence: Planting trees is not against Islam. Infact Islam encourages planting trees According to the district administration, over 6,000 new trees planted by them were removed by these people. The men said that the administration had planted the trees on disputed land without their permission. They staged a protest against the government.
